permitted_methods: HTTP(S) manual testing and standard web vulnerability testing (OWASP Top 10, business logic)
Light non-destructive directory/API discovery with small common wordlists
Nmap service/version scanning and NSE 'safe' scripts on the single approved host
SSH version/banner, algorithm enumeration, auth-method listing (no brute force)
Authenticated web testing via accounts the tester creates on the signup page
prohibited_methods: DoS / DDoS / ReDoS beyond a conservative single-request check
Credential stuffing, password spraying, brute force
Mass exfiltration or disclosure of sensitive data
Testing of third-party / shared infrastructure listed as out-of-scope
notes: Minimum proof-of-concept only. Stop immediately after proof. Report-only on exposed services.
